facts.fact: The Somali Data Protection Authority's Director General Mohamed Nur Olow took part in a consultative meeting on the national interoperability framework and urged anchoring it on data protection.
The Somali Data Protection Authority is headed by Director General Eng. Mohamed Nur Olow, who acted for it at the 2025 meeting; the document names no law.

The Ministry of Communications and Technology held a consultative meeting on the Zero Draft of the National Framework for Digital Interoperability and Integration, with the Office of the Prime Minister and ministries present.
